'''Savielk Trey'dra''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the [[Council Chief]] of the [[Combined Bothan Clans|Bothan Council]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
In his youth, Savielk Trey'dra found a rare copy of ''[[The Way]]'' by [[Golm Fervse'dra]], and applied the philosophies of the [[Bothan Way]] in his personal life. In time, he advanced in prestige, as well as his mastery of it.<ref name="guide" />

Savielk Trey'dra had been a member of the [[Combined Bothan Clans|Bothan Council]] since [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]]<ref>The ''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]'' text mentions that Trey'dra holds his Council presence for "43 consecutive years". According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], therefore his Council career began around 40 BBY.</ref> and holding on the devotion to the ideals of the [[Bothan Way]], building alliances and waiting patiently, he retained his presence for decades, eventually becoming its Chief by the peak of the Civil War.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

In that capacity, he presided over the Bothan people as their de facto ruler, allying with like-minded clan chiefs, or who disagreed with the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. While managing to push his personal agendas through the Council, Trey'dra's efforts and ideals helped his people to stand united against the threat of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule.<ref name="guide" />
